stories.title: Define prescription behavior UI schema and contract
stories.description: Define TypeScript interfaces and UI contract for prescription behavior data including prescribing patterns, condition mapping, and score contribution. Ensure compatibility with backend feature EVAL-P-RX and ingestion pipeline PIPE-RX-INGEST.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx (existing rendering pipeline expects structured content). GAP: No prescription-specific schema defined.

stories.title: Implement prescription behavior rendering logic
stories.description: Build core logic to transform prescription behavior data into display-ready structures including normalization of prescribing patterns, mapping conditions to labels, and calculating relative contribution to overall quality score for UI display.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx (current markdown-based rendering requires pre-processed display data). GAP: No transformation logic exists for prescription measures.

stories.title: Build prescription behavior UI component and integrate into message flow
stories.description: Create a reusable React component to display prescription behavior within provider quality scorecards and integrate it into the MessageBubble rendering pipeline, ensuring proper placement, styling, and fallback behavior.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx (integration point for rendering structured UI in chat). GAP: No dedicated component for prescription behavior display.

stories.title: Add unit and integration tests for prescription behavior UI
stories.description: Develop unit tests for schema validation and transformation logic, and integration tests to verify correct rendering within MessageBubble including edge cases such as missing or partial prescription data.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components (existing component-based architecture supports testability). GAP: No existing tests for prescription behavior UI.
